title: The Irwin Brothers band
summary: He describes the Irwin Brothers band of seven, led by their father, and baritone saxophonist Harris Irwin.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Coleman Hawkins and the great saxophonists

blocks.x: How big a band was the Irwin Brothers?
Oh, it was a small band?
Yes. The father was the leader. James Irwin was a piano player, Dorchester Irwin was a guitar player and Harris Irwin was one of the best baritone saxophone players I ever heard.
now he's in something else. He's got about nine babies. I don't think he's married. But he was exceptionally good.
He's one of the best I've ever heard. He and Carney too. And they played something alike but I don't think they ever even met each other.
I've never heard of, well I mean I've heard of the Irwin Brothers but I didn't know you know, that there were three of them like that.
How many years were they going, do you know?
Oh, they went a long time.

Yes. See, their father was the, was the editor of a, of one of the black papers out in California. I don't remember the name of it. But anyway, I don't even know if he's, they could be, this is such a long time ago, '32 , that's
forty years, they may not, he may be dead by now, I don't know. But he had this paper going and they had the band going and they were a big name out there.
